analysis: Test-only change in provider-swift/Tests/DarkbloomFanHelperTests. The private DaemonBackend/harness in FanDaemonTests.swift was extracted into a new shared FanDaemonTestHarness.swift. The harness gains: a thermalState injection into FanDaemon (uptime/thermalState closures), optional startup temperature/fan-count discovery via FanHardwareReader.discover, read-count/blocked-read/failed-read hooks, FanBackendReadGate, and recordFanOwnership. FanDaemonTests.swift only swaps makeHarness for makeFanDaemonHarness and deletes the private copies. FanStartupDiscoveryTests.swift (3b74ccce69a00081:0) is added, but no content, patch, or text was supplied for it. That is a coverage limit, not evidence of safety. The harness passes journalOwner: nil and requireRootJournalOwnership: false, matching the base harness, so no production ownership-check regression is visible. No production source (FanDaemon, controller, XPC peer code-signing, journal) is changed in the supplied units, so TB-010 mitigations (lease expiry, journal-before-write, Team-ID-pinned XPC) are not weakened here. A reviewer should check whether the same PR changes FanDaemon's new thermalState parameter in production code, since that is outside the supplied units. No findings.
